name: Toast
description: Short messages that stack in a corner, fan out on hover and leave on their own.

props.name: toast(message, options?)
props.description: Shows a neutral toast and returns its id. Call it from anywhere, inside React or not.

props.name: toast.success / error / warning / info
props.description: The same, with the tone's icon and colour. Errors are announced with role="alert".

props.name: toast.promise(promise, messages, options?)
props.type: (promise: Promise<T> | () => Promise<T>, { loading, success, error }) => string
props.description: Shows loading until the promise settles, then turns into success or error in place. success and error may be functions of the result.

props.name: toast.dismiss(id?)
props.description: Dismisses one toast, or every toast when called without an id.

props.name: options.title
props.description: The message, when passing options as the first argument.

props.name: options.description
props.description: A line or two under the title.

props.name: options.icon
props.description: Replaces the tone's icon, or gives a neutral toast one.

props.name: options.action
props.description: A small button, e.g. Undo. Pressing it also dismisses the toast.

props.name: options.duration
props.description: Milliseconds before it leaves. Infinity keeps it until dismissed. Defaults to the Toaster's duration.

props.name: options.id
props.description: Reuse an id to update a toast in place instead of adding another.

props.name: options.onDismiss
props.description: Called when the toast is dismissed, by time, swipe or button.

props.name: position
props.description: Corner the stack grows from. Mount one Toaster per app.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default milliseconds before a toast leaves. Timers pause while the stack is hovered or focused, and while the tab is hidden.

props.name: visibleToasts
props.description: How many toasts show at once. Later ones wait, with their timers paused.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between toasts when the stack fans out.

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance from the edges of the window.
